question: The project board needs to confirm that there is enough information to initiate the project. What should the project beard review? A. Project initiation documentation B. Project brief C. Benefits management approach D. Project plan

Which is a purpose or the ‘initiating a project’ process? A. To prepare the contract for the project to enable the project board to commit to delivery B. To provide the project board with just enough information to decide whether to approve the initiation stage C. To provide the opportunity for the senior user to confirm (hat they find the project product acceptable D. To enable the project board to empower the project manager to work within delegated authority limits

The project manager has created a list or tasks to produce the project’s products. Which step of the ‘organizational design and development’ technique should be informed by this list? A. Design the project ecosystem B. Understand the organizational ecosystem C. Manage the ongoing changes to the project ecosystem D. Develop the project ecosystem

Based on a review or lessons reports from previous projects, some proposals have been made on how to apply PRINCE2 Project Management to a project. Which role should be accountable for approving these proposals? A. Project board B. Project manager C. Project assurance D. Business layer

Why is change management important in a project? A. It provides processes and management products to use when requesting a change B. It provides clarity on how the culture of an organization needs to adapt over time C. It provides confidence that the project can meet its objectives and has continued business justification D. It provides a controlled and bidirectional flow of information to key influencers

The project manager needs to know what modifications have been proposed to an approved product during the stage. Which management product should the project manager review? A. Risk management approach B. Issue report C. Issue management approach D. Issue register
According to the ‘manage by exception’ principle, which aspect of performance sets limits against the cost of aggregated threats? A. Cost B. Scope C. Quality D. Risk

How do issue management and change control relate to each other? A. Change control and issue management are separate processes B. Issue management is part of change control C. Change control is part of issue management D. Issue management and change control are identical
Which plan should be produced depending on the size and complexity of the project? A. Project plan B. Stage plan C. Team plan D. Exception plan

According to the ‘manage by exception’ principle, which statement about tolerances is CORRECT? A. Whenever authority is delegated to the project manager, the project board should set tolerances for the stage B. Whenever there is a forecast to exceed a tolerance, it should be escalated to the project board C. Whenever there is a forecast to exceed a tolerance, it should be resolved at the next monthly project board meeting D. Whenever authority is delegated to the team manager, the focus should be on delivering within time and cost tolerances

When does the ‘directing a project’ process start? A. After the project mandate has been received B. When a request to authorize a project is received C. After the project initiation documentation has been approved D. When the project manager requests authorization to initiate the project

The senior user needs to ensure that the outputs will be used effectively to achieve the outcomes and realize the benefits. Which element of effective business case management is the senior user applying? A. Aligning products to business objectives and tolerances B. Estimating the cost of the project product C. Establishing business justification D. Planning benefit reviews during the project
